business_problem: LG U+ needed a scalable document-oriented foundation for its Agent Assist call-center system because relational databases could not efficiently manage the complex and unstructured data behind real-time support workflows.
solution_summary: LG U+ built its Agent Assist contact-center solution on MongoDB Atlas and Atlas Vector Search to help thousands of service agents access the right information faster during live calls. The platform combines operational customer-service data with vectorized knowledge so the AI system can transcribe conversations, categorize intent, summarize context, and recommend answer guidelines in real time. By moving operational data off PostgreSQL and into Atlas, LG U+ eliminated redundant processes and gained a single environment for document and vector data. Atlas Vector Search gives the AI layer fast semantic retrieval, while the Atlas document model lets the engineering team adapt data structures quickly as the service evolves. The implementation moved from development to launch in four months, giving the call center a more responsive backend for high volumes while reducing delays that previously hurt agent productivity and customer experience.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores operational contact-center data and supports the fast document model Agent Assist depends on.

solution_components.name: Atlas Vector Search
solution_components.role: Retrieves semantically relevant information in real time so Agent Assist can guide customer-service agents during live calls.

data_flow: Customer-service interactions and operational records are stored in MongoDB Atlas, indexed with Atlas Vector Search for semantic retrieval, and then used by Agent Assist to transcribe calls, categorize intent, summarize context, and recommend answers back to live agents.
business_outcome: LG U+ improved resource efficiency by 30%, reduced average processing time per call by 7%, and launched a high-volume AI support service that performs reliably even during peak periods.
